answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work. Reaching the nebula of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The sonnet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the bridge is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
